Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE pixel-art tactical dungeon scene. Image 1 is the NEW STYLE reference: very small economical sprites, thick dark pixel outlines, tiny orange/gold helmets, charcoal clothing, grey simple weapons, low-detail muted green square stone, tiny warm torchlight accents. Stay as simple and low-resolution-looking as this reference; no realistic anatomy, no detailed armor, no microtexture. Image 2 is ONLY our FLOOR PROJECTION reference: copy the steep diamond angles of its large field (tile top width:height 4:3, edge rise 3 for run4). Do not use the reference1 top-down FLOOR camera. Scene: Match the small square guardroom idea of variant 01: closed chest at back, two wall torches, four guards on four well-separated cells. Quiet green stone floor and low back walls.. Characters: four small orange-helmet dungeon guards, with a short sword+shield, a small axe, a compact crossbow, and another plain shield. Chunky compact silhouettes, arms and boots clearly separate, short garments, no hanging trinkets; animation-friendly stable color blocks. Each character's feet stand directly inside ONE clearly identifiable floor tile, centered with generous space to every tile seam. Each sprite is modest in scale relative to a tile. Flat connected floor only, NO circular discs, NO plinths, NO raised single tile under feet, NO display stands. EXPLICIT EXCEPTION FOR CHARACTERS ONLY: draw ALL FOUR as straight-on FRONTAL 2D sprites, faces and chests directly toward the viewer, no top surface of heads, no isometric or side rotation of their bodies. Their feet still rest convincingly on individual cells of the ISOMETRIC 4:3 floor. Keep the floor isometric; only the characters are non-isometric. Square canvas, entire room visible with margins, dark neutral charcoal background, calm floor colors. Few large color clusters per object, hard pixel edges, no blur, no smooth 3D gradients, no particle effects, no motion blur, no glowing weapons. No UI, no text, no watermark, no labels. These are fresh designs in the reference's visual language.

Green rounded hood-like head, dark simple face, short clustered green face tentacles, compact brown/ochre body or robe, planted short feet. request.prompt: Create ONE new pixel art monster study, square canvas. Image1 is the SPECIES REFERENCE only: take the GREEN TENTACLED CTHULHU-LIKE CREATURE in the THIRD ROW, THIRD POSITION from left in image1. Green rounded hood-like head, dark simple face, short clustered green face tentacles, compact brown/ochre body or robe, planted short feet. Preserve its recognizable silhouette and colors but simplify all tiny detail. Do not substitute an eye monster or a human. Image2 is the TARGET STYLE and environment: tiny economical pixel sprite with very simple large color clusters, thick charcoal outline, few colors, short chunky shapes, no tiny texture, no realistic anatomy, no smooth 3D. Match its compact heroes' pixel density and simplicity. Image3 gives the authoritative 4:3 diamond floor projection. Draw this SINGLE monster clearly, in front three-quarter isometric view facing screen LOWER RIGHT, face/eyes visible, never back view. It stands squarely centered on the middle cell of a connected 3x3 green stone floor, all feet/leg tips entirely within that one middle tile with margin to each seam. Modest creature size relative to a tile; show its face and top planes. NO pedestal, NO separate raised tile, NO base disc, NO rock under it. Floor is continuous flat grid, tile diamond top width:height 4:3, deep/steep angle. Surrounding eight cells empty for placement clarity. Dark charcoal background, muted green floor, small quiet cracks only, no room props or other monsters. Animation-friendly separate clear body parts and stable broad color shapes. No UI/text/labels/watermark, no particles/glow, no blur.
